BC_description: The .done method now causes an irrecoverable fatal error in Node.js environments when called, breaking any code that previously used it for promise handling without proper error recovery.
Adaptation_method: Replace .done with .then and .catch to handle promise resolution and errors properly. Example: Before - promise.done(onFulfilled, onRejected); After - promise.then(onFulfilled).catch(onRejected);
RequireInfo: Clarify if this change affects only Node.js environments or also other JavaScript runtimes, and specify the exact version of the library where this breaking change was introduced.
